strings.BLOCK_HAS_ID_IN_PARENT: '{type}' block cannot have an ID when inside parent block '{parent_type}', only for: {invalid_blocks}.
strings.BLOCK_ID_CANNOT_CONTAIN_SPACES: ID '{id}' for block '{type}' cannot contain spaces.
strings.BLOCK_INVALID_ID: '{type}' block has an invalid ID '{id}'. Valid IDs are: {validIDs}.
strings.BLOCK_FORBIDDEN_ID: '{type}' block has a forbidden ID '{id}'. Forbidden IDs are: {forbiddenIDs}.
strings.VALUE_DEPRECATED_REPLACEMENT_VERSION: This parameter is deprecated since version '{version}' and replaced by '{replacement}'. {description}
strings.VALUE_DEPRECATED_REPLACEMENT: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by '{replacement}'. {description}
strings.VALUE_DEPRECATED_VERSION: This parameter is deprecated since version '{version}'. {description}
strings.VALUE_MISSING: Parameter '{key}' is missing a value in block '{type}'.
strings.VALUE_FORBIDDEN: Parameter '{key}' in block '{type}' has forbidden values: {forbidden_values}. Allowed values are: {accepted_values}.
strings.VALUE_INVALID_TYPE: Type '{actual_type}' of '{key}' is invalid for value '{value}'. Expected type is '{expected_type}'.
strings.VALUE_INVALID_OBJECT_FORMAT: Values {values} for parameter '{key}' do not follow the expected 'key{key_value_separator}value' format.
strings.VALUE_INVALID_OBJECT_KEY_TYPE: Key '{obj_key}' for parameter '{key}' is of invalid type '{actual_type}'. Expected type is '{expected_type}'.
strings.VALUE_INVALID_OBJECT_VALUE_TYPE: Value '{obj_value}' for parameter '{key}' is of invalid type '{actual_type}'. Expected type is '{expected_type}'.
strings.VALUE_WRONGLY_FORMATTED_KEY_VALUE_PAIR: Parameter '{key}' in block '{type}' with value '{value}' is likely wrongly formatted. Verify you're not missing a comma or you're not using the '=' symbol incorrectly.
strings.VALUE_WITH_NEWLINE: Parameter '{key}' in block '{type}' has a newline in its value '{value}'. This is usually the symptom of a missing comma.
strings.VALUE_INVALID_BLOCK_REFERENCE: Value '{value}' has a wrongly formatted block reference. Expected format is 'module.block' or 'block'.
strings.VALUE_CANNOT_PROVIDE_MODULE: Value '{value}' cannot contain a module '{module}' reference, only direct block references are allowed.
strings.VALUE_BLOCK_REF_CANNOT_BE_EMPTY: Value '{value}' has an empty block reference, which is not allowed.
strings.VALUE_UNMATCHED_BLOCK_REF: Value '{value}' for parameter '{parameter}' does not match any existing block (expects '{expected_block}' block). Make sure the referenced block exists.
strings.VALUE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK_REFS: Multiple block references found for '{value}' for parameter '{parameter}' (expects '{expected_block}' block). Make sure duplicate block references are not present.
